subject: Cartoon dairy cow holding a milk bottle, sitting, stylized soft-plastic look
observations: White body with one large dark grey patch covering the top of the head and the right ear.
Two dark curved horns; a pale yellow tuft sits between them.
Blush is on the cheeks, below the eyes - not on the body.
Both front limbs wrap around the bottle; the bottle is not free-standing.
unknowns: Rear of the body is not visible in the single reference.

route.views: generate_image, front first then left/rear/right anchored on it
route.refine: blender, only if silhouette fails acceptance

features.description: Reads as a dairy cow, not a bear: dark head patch plus dark horns are both present.
features.accept_when: Patch and horns are visible in the front and both side views.

features.description: Pale yellow tuft between the horns.
features.accept_when: Visible from the front; colour is yellow, not white.

features.description: Both front limbs contact and wrap the bottle.
features.accept_when: Contact is visible from the front and three-quarter views; the bottle does not float.

features.description: Blush sits on the face below the eyes.
features.accept_when: Blush is on the head mass, not on the torso.
